description: This file defines a React component named ProjectsList used to display, filter, sort, and manage a list of projects or spaces, depending on the service type (Jira or Confluence). The component handles UI elements such as search, view toggles, and refresh controls, and renders projects in either grid or list/table views.

methods.name: ProjectsList
methods.description: Main React functional component for displaying projects or spaces with filtering, sorting, and view toggling.
